reviewer: main agent manual semantic review, not independent

semantic_checks.criterion: 自动加载适用Skill并路由成功，关键计算回执通过
semantic_checks.reason: Trace loads global installed Skill and relevant references; route and 10 final receipts pass.

semantic_checks.criterion: 框架不计订单、定点生命周期配套不当年度保证采购，不与生效订单重复加总
semantic_checks.reason: Framework and lifetime nomination volume separated from actual purchase order; no annual guarantee inferred.

semantic_checks.criterion: 生效订单合同金额100万美元有信息价值但非保证兑现；未发出60万、寄售10万、已确认30万区分，不把全部收入未确认部分都武断定义为在手订单
semantic_checks.reason: Cancellable order retains evidential value; original order, unshipped remainder, consignment and recognized revenue distinguished.

semantic_checks.criterion: 已实现毛利6万美元、毛利率20%，不外推订单净利；寄售不认收入
semantic_checks.reason: Batch gross profit and margin calculated, no net-profit or future-margin extrapolation.

semantic_checks.criterion: 现金收取15万美元与收入30万美元分开，预收不认收入；不把应收和订单再加到收入
semantic_checks.reason: Advance separated from recognized-revenue collections; no gross-receipt inference to operating cash flow.

semantic_checks.criterion: 未决取消及交付、费用与净利、同源限制明确，不声称没有订单
semantic_checks.reason: Cancellation, future delivery, cost/expense and issuer-only limitations retained without denying actual progress.

limits: One frozen synthetic case; not real contract verification, accounting certification or broad generalization.
No commit, push, publication or application work.
